summary: Join our specialized training course on cost estimation and budgeting for oil and gas projects. Gain essential skills to advance your career in the industry!
lede: Costing and budgeting for oil and gas projects involves estimating scope-related expenses and creating budgets that can be tracked against approved baselines. For project managers, engineers, estimators, project-controls and finance professionals, the course covers structuring costs, choosing estimation methods, and accounting for uncertainty. Participants also learn to set contingencies, track actuals, analyze variances, and forecast final costs.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who regularly estimate, approve, or manage costs and budgets for oil and gas projects. Whether you're in upstream, midstream, or downstream operations, or a related service provider or regulator, this training will enhance your cost management skills.
audience: Project managers and project engineers in upstream
Cost estimators and project controls professionals
Joint venture and partner relations staff
modules: Foundations of Cost Estimation in Oil and Gas Projects
Cost Estimation for Key Oil and Gas Project Types
Communicating and Defending Estimates and Budgets
Digital Tools for Cost Estimation and Project Controls
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management and financial principles in the oil and gas industry. Prior experience in project estimation or budgeting is beneficial but not mandatory.
